content.short: Perpmate is a privacy-focused perpetuals interface running on Hyperliquid.
content.description: Perpmate is a perpetuals venue powered by Hyperliquid where traders take positions on BTC, ETH, tokenized stocks and gold at up to 50x leverage. No signup is required, since trading happens directly from a connected wallet. Its market list includes index perpetuals such as SP500-USD alongside single-asset crypto pairs.
